thread: Priya: kicking off a staged refactor: moving /docs/reference -> /docs/api-reference. i want to do many tiny PRs (20-30 files each) rather than one giant change. need to coordinate reviewers and a merge cadence. Evan: tiny PRs make sense. can you publish a CSV that maps old->new paths so we can run automated checks? Priya: yes, i'll add mappings.csv and a legacy-anchors.json in the first PR for each chunk. plan: PR-1 move only + redirects.yaml + mappings.csv, PR-2 update anchors and fix cross-links, PR-3 add new SDK snippets and examples. Marta: will reviewers be the same across PRs? i can own auth and deploy sections. Evan can take embeddings. Evan: i'll take embeddings and SDK snippets review. prefer merges before 3pm PT. Build Bot: preview build: https://deploy.previews.redwood.test/1768721111 - build ok, 2 warning(s): broken anchor detected in auth.md (legacy id token-flow). Priya: noted. for the first PR i'm keeping file contents identical to avoid anchor churn. the warning is from PR-2 branch where someone updated wording. i'll revert wording in PR-2 until anchors are stable. Marta: on redirects.yaml format - include only path mappings in PR-1. fragment handling will be in legacy-anchors.json and we will add explicit stubs in targets. Compliance: double-check any private deployment pages for PII exposure during moving. keep access controls. Priya: good call. those pages stay in a restricted folder and we'll move them in a separate controlled PR with Compliance cc'd. Evan: CI suggestion: add a non-blocking job that diffs sitemap and GA top inbound pages so we can sanity-check the most-used pages after each merge. Priya: added to the checklist. Docs Bot: will comment on each PR with redirect manifest and sitemap diff after preview. Docs Bot: comment added to PR-1: "redirects.yaml included, mappings.csv attached, legacy-anchors.json present. Preview warnings: 2 anchors. See details." Priya: timeline: open PR-1 at 09:45 PT, request reviews from @marta and @evan. merge window 10:15-11:00 PT. wait 10 minutes after merge before opening PR-2. Evan: one more thing - label PRs `docs:refactor-phase1` and `ci:anchor-check` so automation can filter. Marta: i'll run a quick grep for external links to the moved paths and paste a prioritized list here. if we find many external anchors i'll flag for infra to add runtime fragment rewrite. Priya: thanks. i'll monitor Sentry and Search Console for any spikes. will post back after PR-1 merge.
